info.prompt: A god's-eye view of Rally Casino's climax—four player avatars arranged around a ten-by-ten grid where overlapping Continue/Bank/Pass decision windows create a kaleidoscope of reaction timers and multiplier ladders, the central board a storm of cascading wild tiles and bomb explosions that illuminate the players' deterministically generated geometric faces in flickering cyan and magenta, their shared vault's emerald glow throbbing in time with the escalating heartbeat soundtrack.
